mechanisms.claim: From the lawful bounded model-effective and rater-effective visible information, every eligible LOCATED_AT assertion has an operationally decidable TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN label and witness/proof of bounded source completeness.
mechanisms.source_basis: Q1 registered; scoped independent design PASS, not actual item verification
mechanisms.discriminating_observation: A blinded adjudicator can reproduce a supported TRUE or FALSE, or justify UNKNOWN_VALID based on a bounded complete permitted domain, using no hidden E_core, with full material-fact parity of both views.
mechanisms.adversarial_falsifier: One purported ELIGIBLE item cannot justify a label from both effective views; rater-only defeating fact; or completeness cannot be established.
mechanisms.confound: A single matching positive witness is insufficient; may miss negation, exclusivity or another label-changing fact.
mechanisms.candidate_decision: KEEP only after prospective lawful validation; otherwise HOLD/SIMPLIFY.

mechanisms.claim: Gold is derived from E_core/answer key/hidden facts absent in one or both effective permitted views.
mechanisms.source_basis: Q1 historical reviewer F-PARITY corrected in design; actual parity NOT_CAPTURED
mechanisms.discriminating_observation: Prospective provenance trace from any prelabel/gold claim to exact model-effective and rater-visible spans, including post-tokenizer/post-truncation view and full material-fact set; compare with separately access-controlled oracle provenance without revealing hidden answer to rater.
mechanisms.adversarial_falsifier: All admitted gold claims have complete independently sufficient effective public witness on both views; no reliance on hidden-only metadata.
mechanisms.confound: Truncation may mimic hidden-only data; source missing truth vs not allowed to see truth must be separately coded.
mechanisms.candidate_decision: HOLD/REJECT affected items; don't silently use hidden oracle or relabel UNKNOWN.

mechanisms.claim: Assertion referent/time/location or source closure is not sufficiently defined for a unique operational label.
mechanisms.source_basis: Q1 F-CONSTRUCT design amendment; X14 exclusive-location caveat
mechanisms.discriminating_observation: Predeclared single triple, explicit time and entity/location IDs, ontology authority and source completeness; independent derivation of mutually compatible truth outcomes.
mechanisms.adversarial_falsifier: A defined qualified domain yields unique reproducible label without hidden disambiguation; alternate locations alone do NOT imply exclusivity.
mechanisms.confound: UNKNOWN_VALID is an admissible truth outcome, whereas INVALID/REJECT_MISSING_WITNESS is outside truth label denominator.
mechanisms.candidate_decision: SIMPLIFY only when localizable before outcomes; otherwise HOLD; PIVOT requires separate Q.

mechanisms.claim: Lexical templates, order, length or style predict adjudication instead of the causal fact relation.
mechanisms.source_basis: FC01 lexical positives restricted and Q1 AD-05 proposed
mechanisms.discriminating_observation: Separately permitted prospective group-disjoint, matched-information semantic contrast keeping nuisance cues fixed plus a cue-only negative control, with rubrics and thresholds frozen before data authoring.
mechanisms.adversarial_falsifier: Under predeclared changes of fact alone vs cue alone, measured decision reliably follows source-visible facts rather than cue position/format; label-change parity verified.
mechanisms.confound: A matched pair changing multiple variables cannot identify a mechanism; AD-06 required IF causal contrast proposed.
mechanisms.candidate_decision: HOLD if leakage or shortcut is unaddressed; no objective/data patch inferred.

mechanisms.claim: The adjudicator's rules/competence/position effects yield scores not determined by the same visible source facts.
mechanisms.source_basis: D1 EXP32 rater-visible custody gap and Q1 independent same-task calibration requirement
mechanisms.discriminating_observation: Blinded independent qualified raters, exactly same task/visible evidence/rubric, calibrated on rights-cleared scope with explicit abstention, disagreement adjudication and format sensitivity checks.
mechanisms.adversarial_falsifier: Prospective independent raters agree under precommitted metric/threshold on admissible evidence, and source-based negative controls show no positional bias.
mechanisms.confound: FRESH16 S1 vs S2 are different roles, NOT a same-task inter-rater reliability result; shared rater bias is possible.
mechanisms.candidate_decision: HOLD scoring pending independent calibration; no model failure attribution.

Rater error may imitate hidden gold/shortcut; do not attribute causality without controlled comparisons

options.trigger: Only when a later owner-authorized prospective protocol verifies lawful source, eligible items, entire material-fact effective parity, independent item gold/rater, shortcut controls and frozen metric/threshold; no contradictory veto.
options.construction: Retain the single LOCATED_AT relation and present rater protocol.

options.trigger: Before outcome exposure prove a LOCALIZABLE ontology failure and a narrower fixed subfamily retaining rights/source visibility/material parity and ability to falsify.
options.construction: Restrict a prereg-declared subfamily (e.g. explicit time/referent), NOT rewrite gold after scoring.
options.discrimination: May rescue construct but narrows external validity

options.trigger: Prove source/ontology of LOCATED_AT fundamentally infeasible and identify a SPECIFIC lawful alternate oracle/task with equal permitted information and independent validation.
options.construction: Propose a NEW Question Gate only after original Q closure and owner decision.

options.trigger: Document irreversible legal/construct/identifiability impossibility and absence of any feasible lawful alternative; lack of rights proof alone is not proof of impossibility.
options.construction: Close this line without a falsified model verdict.

options.trigger: Any unmet hard veto or missing rights, item/witness proof, full parity, calibrated independent raters, threshold, checkpoint/runner consent, or independent review required at current phase.
options.construction: Retain candidate and lineage; block source access, gold authoring, scoring and science until prospective conditions are admitted.

minimum_discriminating_evidence.definition: Document lawful access/use/transformation/third-party rater rights and PII handling before reading any source
Single atomic triple with explicit entity,location,time, visible ontology, domain completeness and allowed TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN vs REJECT; authorization/source proof
Exact source/builder/tokenizer/window and model-effective/rater-effective receipts with full label-changing fact set, not only common witness W; compare hidden oracle only under separate custody
Preregged group-disjoint negative semantic contrast holding lexical/length/order nuisance fixed; separate cue-only perturbation if permitted
Independent qualified same-task blind rater calibration, same permitted packet+rubric, explicit abstention and disagreement adjudication
Predeclare primary endpoint/denominator/threshold/STOP, source sample eligibility, cost/time/resources, reviewer and budget
